# End-to-end gtk4 platform compile test.
#
# Uses the bundled GIR (--opt gir=builtin) so the test runs
# deterministically without requiring system GTK4 dev files. The fixture
# declares a Widget base class the widgets descend from, because that is where
# real GIR declares visible/sensitive/hexpand/tooltip-text and the stdlib
# override bodies in lib/platforms/gtk4/gtk4.sngl are written against them —
# so this archive also checks that the parent-chain merge reaches them.

sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --opt=main=true --opt=gir=builtin --out=out main.sngl
exists out/model.go
exists out/callbacks.go

# cgo preamble: GTK header include
grep '#include <gtk/gtk.h>' out/model.go

# cgo enabled
grep 'import "C"' out/model.go

# The setter for each prop is the C function the fixture GIR names, and the
# enum value is the member's own C identifier.
grep 'gtk_orientable_set_orientation' out/model.go
grep 'C.GTK_ORIENTATION_VERTICAL' out/model.go
grep 'gtk_button_set_label' out/model.go

# GtkImage.file is a property real GIR names no setter for, so the platform's
# own table answers for it — and it wins over the GIR name where both exist,
# which is why a label is set with set_text and not the set_label GIR names.
grep 'gtk_label_set_text' out/model.go
! grep 'gtk_label_set_label' out/model.go

# Button constructor from the inline GIR (gtk_button_new_with_label is the
# first/only constructor in the fixture, exercising the GIR-driven ctor path).
grep 'gtk_button_new_with_label' out/model.go

# tooltip-text and sensitive are declared only on Widget, and reach GtkBox and
# GtkButton down the parent chain. Their setters take a GtkWidget*, so the
# emitted cast is to the ancestor that declares the property and not to the
# widget's own class -- cgo rejects a GtkBox* where a GtkWidget* is wanted.
grep 'C\.gtk_widget_set_tooltip_text\(\(\*C\.GtkWidget\)' out/model.go
grep 'C\.gtk_widget_set_sensitive\(\(\*C\.GtkWidget\)' out/model.go

# Box and ApplicationWindow constructors should also flow through.
grep 'gtk_box_new' out/model.go
grep 'gtk_application_window_new' out/model.go

# GTK app entrypoint emitted in callbacks.go (snglActivate is the //export'd
# activate handler hooked to the GApplication).
grep 'snglActivate' out/callbacks.go

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    var count int

    platform gtk4 {
        GtkApplicationWindow(title="Test") {
            GtkBox(orientation="vertical", tooltipText="a box") {
                GtkLabel(label="hello") {}
                GtkButton(label="click me", sensitive=true, @clicked { count = count + 1 }) {}
            }
        }
    }
}
